atlases.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production-ready transparent PNG sprite atlas for Emoji Delta, a small-scale top-down 2D extraction game. Cohesive hand-painted tactical toy miniatures, clean dark ink outlines, chunky readable silhouettes, restrained military colors with bright identifying accents, soft upper-left highlights, lightly textured materials, excellent readability at 48px. Actual alpha transparency between sprites, no background, no checkerboard baked in, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no borders, no logo, no watermark. Each sprite wholly inside its own cell, independently centered, generous clear padding. Precisely evenly spaced fixed grid, absolutely no overlap between cells. ONE operator sprite atlas, landscape 1536x1024 with exactly 3 columns and 2 rows, six equally sized 512x512 cells. Exactly ONE full-body character per cell, same scale, front three-quarter view from elevated top-down camera, all feet toward bottom, all unarmed with hands ready near chest so equipped weapon will be drawn separately by the game. Head, torso and both feet visible. Proportions stylized large head and compact body, not flat emoji. Row-major order: top left scout wearing light teal scarf, charcoal light rig and headset; top middle balanced tactical operator in navy combat uniform and cyan visor; top right heavy armored operator with broad olive helmet, massive ochre shoulder plates, bulky olive body armor; bottom left combat medic wearing off-white jacket, red medical pouch and red armband with simple white plus; bottom middle sniper in sage green hooded ghillie cape, narrow silhouette and amber goggles; bottom right engineer with orange hard helmet, graphite overalls and visible small tool belt. Make all six immediately distinguishable by silhouette as well as color.
